news.title: Governor proclaims Sept. 6 University of Northern Iowa Sesquicentennial Day
news.summary_en: Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds has proclaimed Sunday, Sept. 6, 2026, as University of Northern Iowa Sesquicentennial Day in recognition of the university’s 150th anniversary.

news.title: Four authors of landmark Iowa cancer report to highlight findings on UNI panel
news.summary_en: Four authors and contributors of the 2026 landmark study linking environmental risk factors to Iowa’s cancer crisis will speak on a panel at the University of Northern Iowa

news.title: UNI students find CPA success through preparation, persistence and faculty support
news.summary_en: What does it take to pass all four sections of the CPA exam before starting your career? For UNI accounting graduates Elise Andersen ’25 and Kailey Koopmann ’25, the answer was preparation, persistence and faculty support — all part of a program ranked No. 1 in the nation for CPA exam success.

news.title: University of Northern Iowa’s 150th anniversary arrives Sept. 6
news.summary_en: UNI will formally recognize the sesquicentennial milestone later this month, with a day of celebrations honoring the university’s 150-year history and its tradition of public service.

news.title: The Schmidt Brothers return home for the 2026 UNI Homecoming Bash
news.summary_en: For the Schmidt Brothers, performing at this year’s UNI Homecoming Bash isn’t just another stop on their busiest touring schedule yet — it’s a return to the campus all three brothers once called home.
